image_description: A small hammerhead shark lying on a grey surface, held by human hands. The shark displays the characteristic T-shaped cephalofoil (hammer head) with eyes at the tips. It has a grey dorsal side and lighter ventral side. Visible fins include pectoral fins and a dorsal fin. There appears to be some red discoloration or injury near the gill/head area.

The connection between the left pectoral fin and the body looks slightly soft and ill-defined, potentially merging with the shadow or the surface below.
There is a red smudge near the gills. While this could be an injury, in AI images, such localized color bleeds often indicate generation artifacts or poor blending of features.
